LESSON: POSITIVE USAGE OF MEDIA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Positive Usage of Media
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Positive Usage of Media, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What types of media do you use at home? 2. How can you use media positively? 3. How can you use media while observing Islamic teachings?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Positive Usage of Media in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Positive Usage of Media in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Positive Usage of Media in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Positive Usage of Media in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning,

   Positive Usage of Media helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation,

   Positive Usage of Media helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life,

   Positive Usage of Media helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately.

   Positive Usage of Media helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify different types of media, including print media, Internet media (such as laptops/desktops, videogames, PlayStation), broadcast media (TV, radio and movies), mobile phones,

2. watch video clips on positive use of media,

3. listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media,

4. discuss the positive and negative uses of media and present in class. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify different types of media, including print media, Internet media (such as laptops/desktops, videogames, PlayStation), broadcast media (TV, radio and movies), mobile phones,
2. watch video clips on positive use of media,
3. listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media,
4. discuss the positive and negative uses of media and present in class. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Positive Usage of Media together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology enhanced as learners watch video clips on positive use of

media.

• Communication: the skill of listening is enhanced as learners listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings

governing the use of media.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners take turns to discuss the positive and negative

uses of media.

30

Values:
• Responsibility is enhanced as learners discuss the positive and negative uses of media, in pairs/ groups, and present in class.

• Integrity is enhanced as learners listen to a resource person discussing the Islamic teachings governing the use of media.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Assertiveness in the proper use of the media.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Science and Technology: as learners search, download and store information from the internet.

Main points to remember:

1. identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning,
2. explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation,
3. observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life,
4. appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately.
